novelty_basis: Termination is a rediscovery - the rule is right barren in McNaughton's sense (OVL(r,l) = {a}, r_alpha = abab; OVL(l,r) = {ab}, l_beta = a, never a suffix of (abab)^k), and every non-overlapping left/right barren one-rule system terminates (R. McNaughton, RPI tech. reports 94-18 and 95-15; A. Geser, ICASE Report 2002-33, Thm 3.2/3.3, https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20020088729/downloads/20020088729.pdf). The exact complexity 2^(n-2) - 1 was not found in the sources read (the report proves linear lengths only for its non-barren case).

statement: The one-rule system aab -> ababa over {a, b} (and its images under reversal and letter exchange) terminates, and the maximal derivation length from words of length n >= 2 is exactly 2^(n-2) - 1, attained by a^(n-1) b.
title: aab -> ababa terminates, with derivational complexity D(n) = 2^(n-2) - 1
